caption: The drawing shows a flintlock musket or rifle rendered in brown, gold, gray, and black tones. The butt and most of the stock are a woodgrain brown, with shading to indicate texture. Gold-colored metal is used for the butt plate, trigger guard, barrel bands, and a decorative end cap at the barrel’s tip. The lock mechanism and trigger are depicted in gray with some shading. There is crosshatching on the stock for grip detail. Below the firearm, there is a separate rectangular golden-yellow plaque or plate illustrated horizontally, featuring engravings. The engravings display three human figures, one holding a spear or staff, one on horseback, and another standing with a sword, as well as a dog-like animal and some simple vegetation or line decorations. In the bottom left corner of the page, the text "JESSIE M. YOUNGS" appears in black font. The background of the drawing is a plain beige or off-white.
title: Blunderbuss
